RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, making it virtually impossible that sex discrimination determined the outcome between you. Raising the panel's gender composition would undermine your credibility, as an all-male panel hiring a male applicant does not demonstrate bias against men. 

While an all-male panel may reflect broader representation issues within senior leadership at the firm, it is irrelevant to why you were passed over. The hiring decision likely came down to non-technical factors, such as client relationship management and business development fit. If you follow up on your request for feedback, focus strictly on interview performance, leadership style, and commercial criteria.
